data.long_meaning: The meaning of Dav is recorded in name-lists as “Beloved”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Dav expresses “Beloved”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dav total 9, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.
